company.name: Common Paper
company.shortDescription: Common Paper develops contract collaboration software to improve the process of commercial contracting.
company.description: Common Paper is a contract-tech startup that helps companies build, negotiate, and sign contracts faster. Common Paper standardizes contracts and the language they use, converting them into APIs and automating the contracting process. Common Paper also provides a solution for managing contract workflow in order to shorten sales cycles and make data easily accessible through computer programming.

productsAndServices.description: A contract lifecycle management platform for startups to create, negotiate, send, sign, store, bill, and renew commercial agreements using structured contract data.
productsAndServices.name: Common Paper Contract Management

productsAndServices.description: An AI contract review agent that applies playbooks to Word and PDF contracts, recommends or inserts counterlanguage, and escalates exceptions to legal, security, finance, or sales owners.
productsAndServices.name: Gerri AI Contract Review

productsAndServices.description: A library of attorney-maintained, open-source commercial contract templates for SaaS sales, confidentiality, privacy, service levels, professional services, partnerships, and related business use cases.
productsAndServices.name: Common Paper Standard Agreements
